newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Logic surges on asset injection hope.
newsitem.headline: Logic surges on asset injection hope.

text.p: Shares of office furniture distributor Logic International Holdings Ltd continued to rise on Thursday on asset injection hopes despite company denials.
Logic shares, which gained HK$0.46 or 73 percent in the last three trading days, added a further HK$0.44 on Thursday morning to HK$1.53 after hitting an all-time high of HK$1.60.
Volume was 106.39 million shares worth HK$154.59 million.
Brokers said speculation of a possible asset injection by Logic's parent China Resources Enterprise Ltd fuelled buying.
"Buying was mainly fuelled by speculation that China Resources might raise its stake in the company through asset injection," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.
Logic said in a statement on Thursday that information regarding possible injections was inaccurate. The company also said no negotiations relating to acquisitions were taking place.
